headline: Global Fuel Shortage Worsens as Refineries Face Damage and Closures
summary: Global fuel shortages worsen as oil refineries are damaged in conflicts involving the U.S., Israel, and Iran, while Russian refining capacity remains constrained.
why: Refinery capacity bottlenecks directly affect global petroleum product supply, driving energy price volatility that impacts broader economic inflation.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Reduced global refining capacity tightens fuel supplies, potentially increasing refining margins and energy prices.

why_moved: Damaged refineries in key regions and restricted export capacity from major producers compounded global fuel shortages, raising supply concerns.
